arms.acquisition_registered: within each physical view, the m surface outputs share one component; five views remain five components
arms.exact_dedup: retain one instance of each exactly equal binary evidence vector, then treat retained vectors as singletons
arms.native_one_per_view: canonical surface only, one output for each of five physical views

assay_gate.decision: gate may stop test inference but may not alter prompts, arms, support, endpoints, or model revisions

claim_boundary: physical-view components are declared separately countable acquisitions, not certified statistically independent sources

fusion.predicted_class: argmax posterior with NOT READY first on exact ties

heldout_policy: run the frozen 1,128-event test only after the development assay passes; never retune from held-out outcomes
models: Qwen3-VL-32B primary and Qwen3-VL-8B replication analyzed separately

multiplicity.rule: m uses the first m surfaces in the frozen order

primary_estimand.point_estimate: equal-weight mean of six task-specific contrasts
primary_estimand.risk: prediction error among retained event-window records

secondary.posterior_drift_reference: L1 distance from native_one_per_view per matched event-window

smoke_used_for: technical validity only; no endpoint, arm, prompt, or support was selected from smoke values

uncertainty.sampling: sample episodes with replacement within task; carry every event, window, view, surface, and arm from each sampled episode
